content_of_post_to_answer: How can I increase my focus on studies instead of my crush?
answer: The problem is often not the crush itself, but the meaning your mind has attached to it. A crush can become a source of imagined rewards, conversations, and possibilities, while studying feels like delayed gratification. Instead of trying to erase the person from your thoughts, notice when your brain is using them as an escape from boredom or pressure. Give your feelings a place, but don't let an imagined relationship consume the time needed to build your real life. A crush should add color to your life, not become the place where your life happens.
